{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if biomarker_final has any -999 (though not documented as sentinel)
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_final: {(df['biomarker_final'] == -999).sum()}")

# Show first few rows to confirm structure
df.head()"}
